channel.title: Transmitter Desk
channel.description: An independent manual for FrSky's ETHOS radio firmware and its desktop Suite: which radios run it, how to update and back up a transmitter, and how it compares with EdgeTX. Facts from FrSky's own pages, checked 7 November 2026.

item.title: FrSky ETHOS: what the radio OS does, which transmitters run it and how to keep it current
item.description: Independent guide to FrSky ETHOS, the transmitter OS for TANDEM, TWIN and Horus ISRM radios: Suite download, firmware updates, model backup, EdgeTX.

item.title: ETHOS Suite download: FrSky Suite 2.0.2 and ETHOS firmware for Windows and Mac
item.description: Where to download FrSky Suite 2.0.2 and ETHOS firmware: installer sizes, Windows and macOS builds, release branches and the first steps after install.

item.title: FrSky ETHOS review: a capable radio OS that only runs on FrSky hardware
item.description: FrSky ETHOS reviewed from FrSky's docs and release notes: model types, 24 channel modules, Lua, Suite, update cadence, limits and a 7.9 score.

item.title: How to update FrSky ETHOS firmware with FrSky Suite, step by step
item.description: Update ETHOS firmware step by step: back up in Model manager, write outdated components, flash the RF module, then update receivers by OTA or S.Port.

item.title: ETHOS backup: how to save and restore FrSky models and radio settings
item.description: Back up ETHOS models with the Suite Model manager or by copying the models folder and radio.bin over USB, and put them back after a flash.

item.title: Which radios run FrSky ETHOS: supported transmitters and Suite requirements
item.description: Radios that run ETHOS per FrSky: TANDEM and TWIN series, Horus X10 and X12 with ISRM, plus targets named in 2026 release notes and Suite requirements.

item.title: ETHOS Suite not working? Fixes for common FrSky update and flashing errors
item.description: Fixes from FrSky's guide: blocked Suite download, no update prompt, stalled update, radio not detected, Device not responding, and a failed flash.

item.title: ETHOS vs EdgeTX: which firmware fits your FrSky radio
item.description: ETHOS vs EdgeTX compared: who builds each, which FrSky radios each supports, companion apps, Lua, licence and what to pick for X10, X12, X18 or X20.
